data.title: Meta Settles With Teen in Trial Over Social Media Harm Claims
data.description: According to CNBC, Meta Platforms settled on Friday with K.D.B., an 18-year-old plaintiff who alleged that Instagram and Facebook were designed to be addictive and caused her mental health problems and disordered eating. The settlement followed the start of jury selection on Wednesday in a trial against Meta and Snap Inc. The case is expected to proceed against Snap only after Meta settled with K.D.B. and had previously settled with the other teen plaintiff, S.J.

data.title: STOCKS | Vail Resorts Gets Baron Capital Backing in Proxy Fight With Oasis
data.description: Baron Capital, one of Vail Resorts Inc.’s largest shareholders, is backing the company and its nominees as it faces a proxy fight with activist investor Oasis Management, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Qatari Negotiators Hold 12 Hours of Talks With Iran in Tehran
data.description: According to Jin10, a diplomatic source told Axios that Qatari negotiators had been in talks with Iranian representatives in Tehran for 12 hours, and negotiations were still ongoing. The source added that Qatari mediators had remained in regular contact with the White House throughout the day, saying that all sides were continuing negotiations to advance an agreement between the United States and Iran.

data.title: STOCKS | Nasdaq 100 (NDX, NDQ, QQQ) Marks Third 2026 Correction as Tech Bets Unwind
data.description: Investors dumped big tech stocks after a slew of disappointing earnings, putting the Nasdaq 100 Index on course to enter its third technical correction of the year, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Polymarket's Lakers vs. Warriors Yaxel Lendeborg 17.5 Points Yes Odds Fall 21.5%
data.description: The Yes option in Polymarket’s “Lakers vs. Warriors” sub-market “Yaxel Lendeborg: Points O/U 17.5” fell from 64.5% to 43%, a 21.5-percentage-point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the change occurred over the past hour.

data.title: UK Maritime Trade Operations: Vessel Struck by Unknown Projectile 40 Nautical Miles South of Iran’s Lavan Island
data.description: According to Jin10, the UK Maritime Trade Operations reported that a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile 40 nautical miles south of Iran’s Lavan Island.

data.title: India Sends Navigation Satellite on GSLV Rocket
data.description: India’s GSLV rocket launched a navigation satellite to bolster the nation’s location-tracking system, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guards: U.S. MQM-170 Drone Captured for Second Time
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran's Revolutionary Guard Aerospace Force said a U.S. MQM-170 reconnaissance drone was forced to land over Qeshm several hours earlier by Iran's advanced electronic warfare system. This was the second time Revolutionary Guard personnel had captured the drone.

data.title: Henrietta Treyz Says Not to Assume Social Security Will Be There
data.description: Henrietta Treyz, co-founder and economic policy research director at Veda Partners, discussed her personal approach to investing and retirement, as well as her views on Social Security’s future, on “Bloomberg Money,” according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Wall Street Faces Midterms, Apple Earnings and Jobs Report as Tech Stocks Slide
data.description: According to CNBC, major U.S. stock indexes were on track for a weekly loss Friday as technology shares sold off after disappointing results from Amazon and Intel. Alphabet fell 12% Thursday, its steepest one-day decline on record, and dropped another 2.2% Friday. Investors are looking ahead to Tuesday’s midterm elections, Apple’s earnings and October’s jobs report. A total of 138 S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report next week. FactSet expects the U.S. to have added 55,000 jobs in October, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.2%.

data.title: JPMorgan Asset Management's Conrath Says Americans Don't Know Their Retirement Number
data.description: Michael Conrath, chief retirement strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, said Americans don't know their retirement number. He joined Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on “Bloomberg Money” to discuss how inflation is prompting Americans to rethink their retirement savings goals, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Polymarket Ethereum October Market Odds for Below $2,200 Rise 17 Points to 59.5%
data.description: The “Yes” option for “Below $2,200” on Polymarket’s “Ethereum October Price Prediction” market rose to 59.5% from 42.5% one hour earlier, a 17-percentage-point increase. According to ChainCatcher, the option’s odds fluctuated sharply.

data.title: AI | Judge Calls for Character Technologies Privacy Ombudsman in Disney Licensing Plan
data.description: A judge said Character Technologies should hire a privacy ombudsman to assess whether its artificial intelligence platform is harmful to children as part of a plan to license some of its technology to Walt Disney Co., Bloomberg reported. The remarks came during a bankruptcy court hearing Friday.

data.title: Owen Zidar’s ‘Everywhere Millionaire’ Says Wealth Often Comes From Businesses Outside Wall Street
data.description: Owen Zidar, author of The Everywhere Millionaire, discussed the book on Bloomberg Money, which says wealth often comes from businesses outside Wall Street, according to Bloomberg. Zidar and hosts Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene also discussed Napoleon Hill’s Think and Grow Rich: The Landmark Bestseller Now Revised and Updated for the 21st Century.

data.title: Colombia Halts Rate Increases as Economic Weakness Emerges
data.description: Colombia halted interest rate increases as signs of an economic slowdown offset fears over accelerating inflation, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Reid Hoffman Gives $8 Million to Wisconsin Democrats as Epstein Fight Enters Election
data.description: CNBC reported that billionaire venture capitalist Reid Hoffman gave $8 million to the Democratic Party of Wisconsin over five weeks to support gubernatorial nominee David Crowley against Republican Tom Tiffany. The contributions, made in four installments from Sept. 24 through Oct. 20, came as Democrats ran ads in House races focused on Jeffrey Epstein and Republicans criticized the party for accepting Hoffman’s money. Hoffman has acknowledged meeting Epstein after the financier’s 2008 conviction and has said he regrets continuing the relationship. House Majority PAC, which received $8.5 million from Hoffman this cycle, ran 13 Epstein-related ads in the past two weeks, spending about $8.4 million, according to AdImpact. Contributions to super PACs are pooled, so Hoffman’s money cannot be traced to specific ads.

data.title: Arini Gets High-Yield Debt Bids From Pimco, Oaktree as Losses Mount
data.description: Arini Capital Management has received bids for some of its high-yield debt holdings from Pacific Investment Management Co. and Oaktree Capital Management amid losses this month, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

data.title: SEC Enforcement Director Says Agency Is Reviewing AI Company Disclosures
data.description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is reviewing disclosures by artificial intelligence companies, its enforcement director said. According to ChainCatcher, the director made the statement.

data.title: Nick Timiraos: FOMC Members Keep Speaking to Explain the Fed’s Policy Reaction Function
data.description: According to Jin10, Nick Timiraos said FOMC members are still speaking frequently to help markets fully understand the Fed’s overall policy reaction function.

data.title: Pakistan Military: Cautiously Optimistic on Iran-U.S. Mediation, but Talks Face Disruptive Forces
data.description: According to Jin10, a Pakistani military spokesperson said the military was "cautiously optimistic" about mediation between Iran and the United States, but negotiations face powerful disruptive factors.
